written.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and search
written.summary: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and agentic workflows, priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens across a 1 million-token context. It is rolling out to Google Search, the Gemini app, AI Studio, and paid Antigravity subscribers, replacing the Flash model.
